chartGroups.name: Lines heard, a run is out
Told wrong, a run is out

classes.end: Between passes: a run is out, a start stamp under a minute old; a run's lines are lost
classes.rule: Every run's lines are judged once: a run that wrote its record has its lines sent, or the record is still on disk for the next pass, or the pass holds it on its way to `_judged`.
classes.cause: the pass marked a record read and died before it sent its lines, so what jmerge said of those pull requests never reaches anyone

classes.end: Between passes: no run out; a run died and nobody is told
classes.rule: A run that died before it wrote its record is told, or its stamp still stands to be told.
classes.cause: a run died before it wrote its record, and its stamp went before any pass said so

classes.end: Between passes: a run is out; the pass said a run left no record, though it did, a record waits for the next pass
classes.rule: The pass says a run ended with no record only of a run that wrote none.
classes.cause: the pass says a run ended with no record while that run wrote one, or is still starting
